result.summary: Verified `git diff main...HEAD -- scripts/test_parallel.sh` directly. (1) No drift from the passed design: cleanup_tmp_dir/1 is defined above the tmp_dir=$(mktemp ...) line, `trap cleanup_tmp_dir EXIT` is registered on the line immediately after tmp_dir's creation and before the echo/validation lines that follow -- matching design section 2.2's required registration point (before the first exit path at the former line 251). The TEST_PARALLEL_KEEP_LOGS env var, its unset-safe `[ -z ... ]` check, the `-eq 0` exit-code test, and the stderr preservation message all match design section 2.3/2.4 verbatim in shape. (2) $? ordering: `local exit_code=$?` is the function's literal first statement, exactly as design section 2.3 mandates ("MUST be the first statement"), so no intervening command (the echo, the if) can clobber it before capture. (3) No scope creep: the diff is purely additive -- one new top-of-file comment block documenting TEST_PARALLEL_KEEP_LOGS, the cleanup_tmp_dir function, and the trap registration line. Nothing else in the ~360-line script (N-derivation, TEST_POOL_SIZE clamp, Step 1.7 concurrency logic, Step 4/5 log-parsing/exit contract) is touched. (4) Decision-record consistency: docs/migration/decisions/0009-test-parallel-pool-sizing.md governs TEST_POOL_SIZE/TEST_MAX_CONNECTIONS/N-budget arithmetic only; this diff does not read, write, or otherwise touch any of those knobs or the connection-budget formula, so there is no contradiction with 0009 or its addenda.
